'''Vasili Yakovlevich Zinger''' ({{langx|ru|Василий Яковлевич Цингер}}; 11 February 1836 – 2 March 1907) was a Russian [[mathematician]], [[botanist]] and [[philosopher]]. His name is sometimes spelled '''Wasili Jakowlewitsch Zinger'''.

==Early life and education==
Zinger was born in [[Moscow]]. His father was a teacher of mathematics. Zinger graduated in 1859 from the [[Imperial Moscow University]], where he majored in [[mathematics]]. He earned a [[doctoral degree]] in 1867. 

==Career==
Zinger was an active member of the [[Moscow Mathematical Society]] and the president of the society (1886–1891).

He also wrote some philosophical essays.

=== Zinger as botanist ===
Zinger was also a botanist and wrote some works about the [[plants]] of central [[Russia]].

''[[Zingeria]]'' of the [[Poaceae]] was named in honour of Vasily Zinger.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.biologie.uni-hamburg.de/b-online/delta/grass/www/zingeria.htm|author=L. Watson, M. J. Dallwitz|title=Zingeria|work=Grass Genera of the World|access-date=October 26, 2009|archive-date=May 15, 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080515182329/http://www.biologie.uni-hamburg.de/b-online/delta/grass/www/zingeria.htm|url-status=dead}}</ref>
